title: Embedding configurations formed from tape words
statement: Let $m,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $\sigma$ embed the indices of $m$ tapes into those of $k$ tapes, and let $q$ be a state. For each of the $m$ tapes, let $v_i$ be a Boolean word; for each of the $k$ tapes, let $\mathrm{frame}_j$ and $\mathrm{target}_j$ be Boolean words. Suppose $\mathrm{target}_{\sigma(i)}=v_i$ on every selected tape and $\mathrm{frame}_j=\mathrm{target}_j$ on every unselected tape. Then embedding the configuration formed from the words $v_i$, using the framed words on unselected tapes and an empty output prefix, gives the configuration formed from the target words, on the same Boolean input and in state $q$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
Framed and target Boolean words on the $k$ tapes
Selected target words equal the corresponding source words
Unselected framed words equal the target words
